title: Jazzy Cheese Canadian Cheese Pizza
description: A festive Canadian dish featuring pico de gallo sauce, perfect for a wood-fired bake. This recipe is halal-friendly and has a beautiful briny, cheese-pull.

ingredients.name: Cottage cheese
ingredients.notes: Extra creamy for the best cheese-pull.

instructions: Roll out the pizza dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Spread the pico de gallo sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the bacon bits, cottage cheese, cheddar cheese, and mozzarella cheese over the sauce.
Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the cheese for an extra burst of flavor.
Transfer the pizza to the preheated oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pizza from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro for garnish.
Let the pizza cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
